home.tagline: Open a book. Find your own way through.
home.bookshelf_help: Open a new adventure or pick up where you left off.
home.bookmark_help: Tap a bookmark to resume your story.
home.bookmark_restart_help: This replaces your saved place and choices in this book. Your hero name and reading settings will stay the same.

hero_setup.heading: This adventure belongs to…
hero_setup.world_name_fallback_label: What would you like to name your world?

story.ready_prompt: Press Continue when you're ready to see your choices...

reader.size_preview: Find the type and paper that feel comfortable to read.
reader.preset_large_description: 175% · Bold sans serif · Spacious · Clear paper
reader.gesture_help: Swipe left or right to turn a page. Tap the left edge to go back, the right edge to go forward, or the middle to show or hide controls. The choices follow the last page of each scene. Tap Aa for reading settings. Pinch to zoom in for a closer look. On the first page after a choice, Back to choice replaces Previous so you can choose again.
reader.system_size_help: Your iPhone or iPad text-size setting is applied automatically. This control adjusts the book size further.
reader.voiceover_help: VoiceOver reads the passage continuously. Use your usual VoiceOver gestures to read and navigate, then choose what happens next below the passage.
reader.pageMovement_help: Instant changes pages without animation. Reduce Motion always keeps page changes instant.

errors.invalid_choice: Hmm, that wasn't one of the choices. Try again!
errors.unknown_scene: Something went wrong loading that scene.

save_recovery.heading: Your saved bookmarks need attention
save_recovery.preserved: We have not changed or deleted your saved progress.
save_recovery.confirm_body: This removes every saved book’s place, names, and choices from this device. You can then start new adventures. This cannot be undone.

reasons.malformed: We couldn’t read the saved progress on this device.
reasons.unsupported_version: This saved progress uses a version this app doesn’t support. Try opening it with the version of the app that saved it.
reasons.unknown_story: The book for this saved progress isn’t available in this version of the app.
reasons.unknown_scene: The page for this saved progress isn’t available in this version of the app.
reasons.storage_unavailable: This app can’t access saved progress on this device right now. Check your browser’s storage permissions, then try again.
reasons.reset_failed: We couldn’t delete the saved progress. Check your browser’s storage permissions, then try again.

image_viewer.title: Illustration
image_viewer.zoom_help: Pinch to zoom. Drag to explore.

runtime_recovery.heading: Let’s reopen your book
runtime_recovery.body: Something went wrong displaying this screen. Return to the bookshelf to try again.
runtime_recovery.preserved: Returning to the bookshelf will not change or delete your saved progress.

persistence.heading: Saved progress needs attention
persistence.write_failed: We couldn’t save that action. Your saved progress has not been replaced. Try again when storage is available.
persistence.delete_failed: You can still read the ending. We couldn’t clear its bookmark, so it may appear again on your bookshelf. Try again when storage is available.
persistence.save_changed: Saved progress changed in another window. We left that bookmark untouched. Return to the bookshelf to load it.
persistence.navigation_failed: We couldn’t open the next page. Your saved place is unchanged. Return to the bookshelf to resume.

passages.title: Saved passages
passages.help: Keep favorite moments to read again. Your adventure keeps its own place.
passages.read_only: This is a saved passage. Your adventure and choices stay where you left them.
passages.empty: No saved passages yet. Use the bookmark button while reading to save a favorite moment.

errors.unavailable: Saved passages are unavailable right now. Your adventure is unaffected. Try again.
errors.invalid: This collection could not be read. It has been left untouched.
errors.conflict: Saved passages changed in another window. Try again to use the latest collection.
errors.write_failed: This change could not be saved. Your previous passages are unchanged. Try again.

purchase.title: Keep the adventure going
purchase.help: Enjoy the opening of each book for free. One purchase opens every path and ending in these three adventures.
purchase.boundary_help: You’ve reached the end of this book’s free opening. Unlock all three adventures to follow your next choice. Your place is saved.
purchase.owned_help: Every path and ending in these three adventures is yours to read.
purchase.terms: One purchase. No subscription. Includes future updates to these three books.
purchase.locked_passage: Unlock the library to read this saved passage.

messages.access_error: Your purchase status could not be checked. Try again or restore your purchase. Your bookmark is safe.
messages.unavailable: The store is unavailable right now. Try again when you have a connection. You can still read the free openings.
messages.restricted: Purchases are restricted on this device. You can still restore an existing purchase and read the free openings.
messages.ios_only: Purchases are available in the iPhone and iPad app.
messages.pending: Waiting for purchase approval. You can keep reading the free openings; access will update when Apple approves the purchase.
messages.cancelled: Purchase cancelled. Your place is unchanged.
messages.nothing_to_restore: No library purchase was found for this Apple Account.
messages.purchase_error: The purchase could not be completed. Please try again. Your place is unchanged.
messages.restore_error: Your purchase could not be restored. Check your connection and Apple Account, then try again.
messages.verification_failed: Apple’s purchase verification was unsuccessful. Access has not changed. Try restoring your purchase.
